verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Omarchy Quattro can be installed to a single partition alongside Windows or other installations. The manual also has a dedicated page on dual booting beside Windows, so this is a documented installer capability. Missing for 10: the dual-boot guide's actual contents (bootloader handling, partitioning steps) are not in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on report of a dual-boot install.
